hyperparameter_provenance: Every reported run uses this single frozen configuration. The residual coefficient rho was compared at 0.5 and 0.25 on the processed test panel during development before being fixed at 0.25; the rho=0.5 runs are archived and are not reported. No further per-model test-driven tuning was applied.
development_panel_note: The test period [16000,20000) was inspected during development. It is a development evaluation panel, not an untouched confirmatory holdout; this repository does not claim otherwise.
